rationale: Research-scale Fletcher queue target; requires physical identity, geographic coverage, actual full-raster inspection and browser verification. Printed graticules are search guides only.
scope: Inspect entire source and preserve mapped neatline, islands, extensions and crossing labels. Keep unsupported regions visible in the draft and excluded from acceptance.
fit_policy: Review original native crosshairs and actual modern geometry. Preserve each failed or rejected stage, freeze repairs before fresh checks, never silently fit validation points.
